Metadata.Title: Diablo III
Metadata.Name: Resolution Patch
Metadata.Params: render_width render_height render_aspect camera_aspect small_fonts big_heap
Metadata.Note: Renders at render_width x render_height (sanctuary.ini render_resolution, run.py); camera_aspect also writes the camera's aspect ratio (render_aspect, width / height) and small_fonts gives screens below 1080 lines the 1080p fonts (the game has none for smaller screens).
Metadata.Author: SanctuaryPort

Metadata.Title: Diablo III
Metadata.Name: Resolution Patch
Metadata.Params: render_width render_height render_aspect camera_aspect small_fonts big_heap
Metadata.Note: The same for the US 1.00 eboot; big_heap (above 1600x900) also grows the display buffers' heap to 224 MiB as in 1.47. Requires setting DMEM to 256 MB.
Metadata.Author: SanctuaryPort

Metadata.Title: Diablo III
Metadata.Name: Max Foreground FPS - 200
Metadata.Note: With the Frame Limiter patch that does not wait the game reaches up to 200 FPS instead of about 143: its second frame limiter (the PC game's Max Foreground FPS, 150 by default) is asked for 200, the setting's maximum. Applied by Graphics > Frame rate 200 FPS.
Metadata.Author: SanctuaryPort

Metadata.Title: Diablo III
Metadata.Name: Text Size - Layout Size
Metadata.Note: Text is drawn at the font size its layout measured: the largest one at or below the size asked for (the game drew the next larger one, so at 800 or 900 lines text overflowed its box). Applied by run.py at render resolutions other than 1080 and 2160 lines.
Metadata.Author: SanctuaryPort

Metadata.Title: Diablo III
Metadata.Name: Text Size - Both Font Sets
Metadata.Note: Between 1080 and 2160 lines the game loads its 2160p fonts with its 1080p ones, so text keeps its size (it had only the 1080p sizes: at 1440p the quest dialog subtitles were three quarters of their size). Applied by run.py with Text Size - Layout Size.
Metadata.Author: SanctuaryPort

Metadata.Title: Diablo III
Metadata.Name: Frame Limiter
Metadata.Note: The game's frame limiter waits frame_wait microseconds per frame instead of 16683 (59.94 Hz); 0 does not wait (sanctuary.ini frame_rate, run.py).
Metadata.Author: SanctuaryPort

Metadata.Title: Diablo III
Metadata.Name: Frame Limiter
Metadata.Note: The same for the US 1.00 eboot.
Metadata.Author: SanctuaryPort

Metadata.Title: Diablo III
Metadata.Name: Experimental: Smooth character motion above 60 FPS
Metadata.Note: Above 60 FPS the hero and monsters move only on every other frame and look jittery; this places them where they are at the moment of each frame. No change at 60 FPS or below.
Metadata.Author: SanctuaryPort

Metadata.Title: Diablo III
Metadata.Name: Dynamic Resolution - Off
Metadata.Note: The scene stays at 100%: the dynamic resolution always takes the game's own fixed-scale branch.
Metadata.Author: SanctuaryPort

Metadata.Title: Diablo III
Metadata.Name: Game MSAA - 4x
Metadata.Note: The scene is drawn with 4 colour and depth samples (MSAA level 16).
Metadata.Author: SanctuaryPort

Metadata.Title: Diablo III
Metadata.Name: Offline Seasons
Metadata.Note: Shared part of the offline seasons (choose one 'Offline Seasons - Season N'): answers the Seasons.txt and Config.txt requests locally, skips the server-time check and validates seasonal heroes. Code in the unused zero padding at the end of the code segment.
Metadata.Author: thanosdk28

Metadata.Title: Diablo III
Metadata.Name: Offline Seasons - Season
Metadata.Note: Offline seasonal heroes for one season (a Preset: 'Offline Seasons - Season N'): the base plus the season number (season, two ASCII digits), its community events (season_theme: one byte per event of the cave's table), the Altar of Rites (altar) and Visions of Enmity (visions).
Metadata.Author: SanctuaryPort

Metadata.Name: Event: Challenge Rifts
Metadata.Note: Offline Challenge Rifts: the game reads challengerift_config.dat and challengerift_N.dat from user/data/pubfiles (you supply the files; see patches/challenge_rift_data/README.md), with the challenge number of the current week, so the Challenge Rift cache can be earned once a week and claimed in town.
Metadata.Author: thanosdk28

Metadata.Title: Diablo III
Metadata.Name: Event: The Darkening of Tristram
Metadata.Note: Offline anniversary event: the portal to the Diablo 1 dungeon in the Old Ruins of Tristram is open (Adventure Mode). The game decides the event from the date; this makes it answer "open" (status 1) for the three places that ask. Works in any game, season or not. Experimental.
Metadata.Author: thanosdk28

Metadata.Title: Diablo III
Metadata.Name: Offline: no sign-in warning
Metadata.Note: Makes the online-state check (eboot 0x668c0) report OK and skips the sign-in checks, so the 'not signed in / ineligible for leaderboards' dialog does not show before a season or a Challenge Rift.
Metadata.Author: thanosdk28

Metadata.Note: Items are picked up by walking over them, like gold; items you drop yourself stay on the ground.
Metadata.Author: SanctuaryPort

Metadata.Name: Cheat: Kanai's Cube keeps materials
Metadata.Note: Kanai's Cube recipes do not use up crafting materials (you still need to have them); the items you put in are still used.
Metadata.Author: SanctuaryPort

Metadata.Title: Diablo III
Metadata.Name: Cheat: Unlock all difficulties
Metadata.Note: Every difficulty up to Torment XVI can be chosen, whatever the hero's level.
Metadata.Author: SanctuaryPort

Metadata.Title: Diablo III

Metadata.Note: Myriam the Mystic (enchanting, transmogrification) joins in Act V, as before Blizzard made her join in Act I after The Legacy of Cain. Adventure Mode still brings her, and an account that already has her keeps her.
Metadata.Author: SanctuaryPort
